spec.scope: Research direct BTCUSDT perpetual exchange economics and a bounded model improvement experiment; no broker credentials or orders.
spec.prior_exposure: All 2020-2025 history has been exposed in this repository. Chronological testing here is diagnostic, not fresh confirmation. 2026 data, if obtainable and not already locally used, are a separately labeled later-period check, not a prospective live test.
spec.baseline: Frozen original model predictions, p>=0.55 long / p<=0.45 short, plus its originally published 0.50 direction rule. No tuning of original model.
variants: recent_logistic: original features, StandardScaler + LogisticRegression C=0.1; most recent 24 months of training; separate following six-month Platt calibration

nonlinear_direction: original features plus lagged realized volatility, lagged return/volatility, taker-flow interactions and UTC cyclical clock; HistGradientBoostingClassifier max_iter=120,max_leaf_nodes=15,max_depth=4,learning_rate=0.05,l2_regularization=10,min_samples_leaf=300; following six-month Platt calibration

nonlinear_return: same expanded features; HistGradientBoostingRegressor with same fixed hyperparameters, squared_error and training-target clipping at 0.5/99.5 percentiles; following six-month predicted-return linear calibration
spec.horizon_interpretation: 5, 15 and 30 minutes are separate declared trials. Only the first is the original five-minute objective.
spec.training: 2021-07-01 through 2023-06-30, with a 35-minute label embargo at boundaries
spec.selection: 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31; choose at most one trading rule per model/horizon using net mean daily P&L at 12bps round trip
spec.diagnostic_test: 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31; rules frozen on 2024 and all results retained, including failures
spec.cost_semantics: All-in hypothetical round-trip trading friction, not a claim of actual account fees or fills. 2bps is an aggressive economic floor; 12bps is a perpetual taker scenario, 24bps a low-fee spot scenario. Funding is separately charged at observed settlement times, when available.
spec.execution: Separate non-overlapping fixed-horizon positions, 1x initial notional, flat between eligible signals, no leverage. Entry at decision bar open and exit at open h bars later are optimistic bar-reference prices, not executable quotes. Also evaluate unchanged signal with a full five-minute entry delay and same holding duration. Ties retained if reconstructing new panels. Long-only is a diagnostic on perpetual prices, not a validated spot implementation.
spec.uncertainty: Circular seven-day block bootstrap, 2000 replications, seed 93026; interval for per-trade expectancy computed using daily P&L sums divided by daily trade counts. Multiple comparison adjustment reported separately using Bonferroni one-sided alpha across nine candidate model/horizon rows.
spec.gate: At least 500 selected trades; positive 2024 net expectancy at 12bps; positive 2025 net expectancy and its multiplicity-adjusted lower interval; positive each half of 2025; positive five-minute delayed net. Only a surviving candidate merits acquiring new confirmation/executable quote evidence. No claims of profitability from bar reference alone.
spec.stop: Do not search additional parameters, thresholds, horizons or reverse failed signals after observing results. Preserve original artifacts. A failure closes this bounded experiment, not all possible BTC trading.

limitations: Binance bar references are not executable quotes or Coinbase contract prices. A failing cheap reference scenario is evidence against this signal, not a backtest on every exchange.
Historical data were already exposed. No retrospective result constitutes independent prospective confirmation.
Funding uses settlement rates and Binance trade-price reference rather than historical mark prices; exact boundary events excluded under reference convention.
Fixed-initial-notional P&L may fall below -100% in stress; that means insolvency/stop before full replay. It is not a feasible compound account return.
No liquidity, queue, maker fills, market impact or liquidation simulation. Zero-fee rows are mathematical sensitivity only.

Selection thresholds and horizon comparisons are nine model/horizon trials, each with three 2024 thresholds; Bonferroni interval is a diagnostic family correction, not correction for the repository entire research history.
